text: 10月21日上午，国务院总理李强在圣彼得堡同俄罗斯总理米舒斯京共同主持中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤。李强表示，中方愿同俄方发扬相互尊重、互利共赢精神，推动各领域合作不断走深走实，把两国元首重要共识更好转化为实际行动和具体成效，更好服务两国发展振兴，更多惠及两国人民。
text_en: On the morning of October 21, Premier Li Qiang of the State Council co-chaired the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting with Russian Prime Minister Mishustin in St. Petersburg. Li Qiang said that China is willing to work with Russia to carry forward the spirit of mutual respect and win-win cooperation, promote steady and deepening cooperation in various fields, better translate the important consensus of the two heads of state into practical actions and concrete results, better serve the development and revitalization of the two countries, and bring more benefits to the two peoples.
